title: LOCKED behaviour: sidecar `pattern` absence is lenient at the SHARED validator (both languages)
why: absence-LENIENT for `pattern` — a pre-freeze sidecar never stamped one, and
the SHARED structural validator does not dispatch on it (that is
`_require_pattern`'s job, kind DISPATCH, layered on top in Python's
Loaded* classes — see the `LoadedVector`/`LoadedPure` GPU-gated pins in
test_schema_hardening.py, which is where THAT further dispatch is pinned;
it needs a real device module load and so cannot be a GPU-free corpus row).
Unlike the manifest-level `pattern` gate (row 13), this is NOT a
cross-language asymmetry — both languages agree (ACCEPT) — so no override
is needed; this row locks the shared agreement itself.
ACCEPT is asserted at shared_validator only (row 11's precedent): driving
an accept case through host_add_plugin would dlopen a stub path and fail
for an unrelated reason, proving nothing about validation.
